parts.provenance: Original work: the in-code molded builder's construction (crates/solidcraft-integration/src/models/molded.rs, retired with these files) rebuilt by SolidCraft commands in `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` at a typical size of its class; the molded generator gives every parameter but the band's and the marking area's, which follow the body. Outline proportions from the public JEDEC DO-214 and DO-213 outlines, EIA-535 tantalum case sizes and estimated SOD values; estimated leadframe, bends and rounds; no vendor drawing or EDA/CAD library data copied.
